Row.SQL: WITH check_mutation_result AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT $1::uuid AS "id", $2::uuid AS "author_id", $3::text AS "title") AS data WHERE data."author_id" = $4::uuid), check_count AS (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM check_mutation_result) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE (SELECT 0 FROM (SELECT constellation_throw_error('check constraint of an insert/update permission has failed', 'ZZ901')) x) END AS status), mutation_result AS (INSERT INTO "public"."notes" ("id", "author_id", "title") SELECT check_mutation_result."id", check_mutation_result."author_id", check_mutation_result."title" FROM check_mutation_result WHERE (SELECT status FROM check_count) = 1 RETURNING *) SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json("_physical")), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT "id"::text AS "id", "author_id"::text AS "author_id", "title"::text AS "title" FROM mutation_result) AS "_physical"

Batch.SQL: WITH insert_data AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT $1::text AS "body", $2::text::pg_catalog.uuid AS "note_id" UNION ALL SELECT $3::text AS "body", $4::text::pg_catalog.uuid AS "note_id") AS data), _mutation_result AS (INSERT INTO "public"."note_replies" ("body", "note_id") SELECT insert_data."body", insert_data."note_id" FROM insert_data RETURNING *), post_check AS (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM _mutation_result WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."notes" g WHERE _mutation_result."note_id" = g."id" AND g."author_id" = $5::uuid) AND _mutation_result."visibility" = $6::text) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM _mutation_result) THEN 1 ELSE (SELECT 0 FROM (SELECT constellation_throw_error('check constraint of an insert/update permission has failed', 'ZZ901')) x) END AS status), mutation_result AS (SELECT * FROM _mutation_result WHERE (SELECT status FROM post_check) = 1) SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json("_physical")), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT "id"::text AS "id", "note_id"::text AS "note_id", "visibility"::text AS "visibility", "body"::text AS "body" FROM mutation_result) AS "_physical"

Insert.FinalSQL: WITH mutation_result AS (SELECT (value ->> 'id')::text::pg_catalog.uuid AS "id", (value ->> 'author_id')::text::pg_catalog.uuid AS "author_id", (value ->> 'title')::text::pg_catalog.text AS "title" FROM json_array_elements($1::json) AS "_rows"(value)), nested_affected_rows AS (SELECT generate_series(1, $2::integer)) SELECT json_build_object('affected_rows', ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mutation_result) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nested_affected_rows)), 'returning', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json("_e")), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT mutation_result."id" AS "id" FROM mutation_result) AS "_e"))
